games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which word names a way to travel?
rounds.explanation: You can travel in a bus; a window, an apple and a cloud do not take you anywhere.

rounds.prompt: Which one travels on water?
rounds.explanation: A boat goes on the water; a bus and a bicycle go on the road and a train goes on rails.

rounds.prompt: Which one flies in the sky?
rounds.explanation: A plane flies; a car and a train stay on the ground and a boat stays on the water.

rounds.prompt: Which one has only two wheels?
rounds.explanation: A bicycle has two wheels; cars, buses and trains all have many more.

rounds.prompt: Which one moves along rails?
rounds.explanation: A train runs on rails; a car uses the road, a boat uses water and a plane uses the sky.

rounds.prompt: Sami comes to school in a bus. Which sentence is correct?
rounds.explanation: We say I go by bus for one bus; the other sentences have the words in the wrong order or the wrong form.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: What two colours was the big bus?
choices: She called out to her, and Amal ran and hugged her
rounds.explanation: The story says a big bus came and it was yellow and red.

rounds.prompt: Where did Amal sit on the bus?
choices: I go by ___. (for example: I go by bus.)
rounds.explanation: Mum says 'Find a seat,' and Amal found a seat by the window.

rounds.prompt: How did Amal travel first, before she went by bus?
choices: It goes on the ___. (for example: on the road.)
rounds.explanation: Mum says, 'First we walk. Then we go by bus.'

rounds.prompt: Who was riding a bicycle and waved at Amal?
choices: She called out to her, and Amal ran and hugged her
rounds.explanation: Amal sees a boy on a bicycle who waves, and his name was Adam.

rounds.prompt: How do we know Grandma was glad to see Amal?
choices: I go by ___. (for example: I go by bus.)
She called out to her, and Amal ran and hugged her
rounds.answer: She called out to her, and Amal ran and hugged her
rounds.explanation: Grandma calls, 'Amal! You came to see me!' and Amal gives her a big hug.

rounds.prompt: Which talk line tells how you travel?
choices: I go by ___. (for example: I go by bus.)
It goes on the ___. (for example: on the road.)
rounds.answer: I go by ___. (for example: I go by bus.)
rounds.explanation: 'I go by ___' is the talk line for how you travel.

games.title: Memory Pairs
games.description: Reveal tiles and connect each word with its meaning.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 1.
pairs: ring
Ring means to make a clear, loud sound like a bell.
these
This word points to more than one thing close to you.
our
This word means belonging to us.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 2.
pairs: was
Was means the same as is, but it already happened.
make
To build or create something new with your hands.
beep
A beep is a short, sharp sound that a horn makes.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 3.
pairs: ding
A ding is a short, ringing sound that a bell makes.
swallow
A swallow is a small bird with pointed wings that flies fast.
wings
Wings are the parts of a bird's body that it uses to fly.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 4.
pairs: bicycle
A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pedalling.
wheels
Round parts that turn so a vehicle can move.
drive
To make a car or bus go where you want.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 5.
pairs: sit down
To put your body onto a chair or the floor.
up
Towards a higher place, like the sky above your head.
big
Large in size, taking up lots of space.

rounds.prompt: Match vocabulary set 6.
pairs: yellow
The colour of the sun and school buses.
behind
Behind means at the back of something.
near
Close to something, only a short walk away.
